about: Opus front verdicts on the front-check montages (artifacts/repeated-buildings/front-check/<group>.jpg), 2026-11-15, by a fresh reviewer that did not build the detector. Membership is decided on the front photo; the footprint group is only the candidate. Pands are given by their last 6 digits and resolved against front-check.json copiesDetail. exact = one model fits every member bar paint; near = one design family with variants; false = different buildings that share a footprint.

families.name: Staatsliedenbuurt red-door banded block
families.front: 4 storeys plus cornice with small dormer pediments; dark red-brown brick with cream speklagen and cream window-head blocks; paired red doors; no balconies. 163783 and 164255 carry a ground-floor shop (corner variant).

families.name: Frederik Hendrikbuurt red-door banded block
families.front: 4 storeys, red-brown brick, white window heads and bands, paired red doors, flat cornice with small dormer pediments (same corporation style as 1898-160905).

families.name: Frederik Hendrikbuurt block, gabled centre
families.front: same facade, crown with a central stepped or neck brick gable

families.name: Hoofdweg Amsterdam School block (Wijdeveld)
families.front: 4 storeys, brown brick, flat roof with a row of small square attic windows, white window bands, paired painted doors (door colour is paint only).

families.name: Hoofdweg block, corner loggia stair tower
Orteliusstraat 1932 block with bays and roof band
families.front: 3 storeys dark-brown brick under a red-tile hipped roof with small dormers; top floor a continuous white window band with short white piers; floors 1-2 wide shallow bays with white frames; recessed open stair entrances.

families.name: Sarphatistraat arched-door block (Berlage)
families.front: 4 storeys, brown brick, paired round-arched ground-floor doorways, small balconies on the upper floors, flat cornice with small dormers.

families.name: Roomtuintjes 1974 gallery block segment
families.front: 4-storey red-brown brick block, continuous green-glass balcony band, white window grid, garage-door plinth; one long building split into pands (075294 and 147606 are end bays).

families.name: Nieuwendammerdijk 1987 dormer terrace house
families.front: brick ground floor, steep dark tiled roof with a large white box dormer, white porch/garage panel; 137179 is an end house.

families.name: Marnixstraat red-brick block
families.front: 4 storeys, red brick, cream segmental window heads, cornice with small dormer pediments; shop bases on 173376, 172787, 172599, 172786.
